evidence_packet.evidence_text: Top Gear to return – 4 years after Andrew Flintoff crash News Hackers steal customer data from millions of Manchester Airport Group passengers Publishing Mirror heads North with ‘new’ Manchester base as Liverpool Echo names new editor Mirror heads North with ‘new’ Manchester Mirror North will launch at the end of September and, according to Reach, provide a base for Mirror journalists living in the region as the national title looks to attract more talent from outside London But details of exactly what the new operation will look like remain unclear Maria Breslin Reach has not said how many journalists will be based at Mirror North, whether it will create any new editorial jobs beyond Breslin’s newly created role, or whether the operation will have its own dedicated newsroom or northern editorial remit There is also a question over how substantially the arrangement differs from the existing set-up, under which Reach journalists have been able to work from hubs across its network The Manchester Evening News has been based at Reach’s large Oldham site since 2010, which also houses the publisher’s printing operation. The same building previously hosted the Mirror’s northern team when the company operated as Trinity Mirror
